levels.d: The national level legislates and carries out.
levels.df: سطح ملی قانون می‌گذارد و اجرا می‌کند.

levels.d: The national level legislates; the regions carry the law out.
levels.df: سطح ملی قانون می‌گذارد؛ مناطق آن را اجرا می‌کنند.

levels.d: The national level lays down principles or minimum rules; the regions legislate the rest.
levels.df: سطح ملی اصول یا حداقل‌ها را می‌گذارد؛ مناطق باقی را قانون‌گذاری می‌کنند.

levels.d: National level and regions both act, each within its powers, or jointly.
levels.df: سطح ملی و مناطق هر دو، هر یک در حدود اختیار خود یا با هم، عمل می‌کنند.

levels.d: The regions hold the field; the national level at most supports or coordinates.
levels.df: حوزه با مناطق است؛ سطح ملی حداکثر پشتیبانی یا هماهنگ می‌کند.

levels.d: Municipalities and villages hold the field, alone or by agreement with the region.
levels.df: حوزه با شهر و روستاست، به‌تنهایی یا با توافق منطقه.

regional offices of the central government

scale_fa: بی‌اداره‌ی منطقه‌ای
اداره‌ی منطقه‌ای وابسته به مرکز
حکومت منطقه‌ای خود، با حق وتوی مرکز
حکومت منطقه‌ای خود، بی‌وتوی مرکز

scale: centre sets base and rate of all regional taxes
region sets the rate of minor taxes
base and rate of minor taxes
rate of at least one major tax (income, corporate, VAT, sales)
base and rate of at least one major tax
scale_fa: مرکز پایه و نرخ همه‌ی مالیات‌های منطقه‌ای را تعیین می‌کند
منطقه نرخ مالیات‌های کوچک را تعیین می‌کند
پایه و نرخ مالیات‌های کوچک
نرخ دست‌کم یک مالیات بزرگ (درآمد، شرکت، ارزش افزوده، فروش)
پایه و نرخ دست‌کم یک مالیات بزرگ

borrows with prior central approval and central limits
borrows without prior approval, under central limits
borrows without central limits

با تایید پیشین مرکز و زیر قیدهای مرکز وام می‌گیرد
بی‌تایید پیشین، زیر قیدهای مرکز
بی‌قید مرکز

scale: assembly: none 0, indirectly elected 1, directly elected 2; executive: appointed by the centre 0, dual 1, chosen by the assembly or directly elected 2 (sum)
scale_fa: مجلس: نیست ۰، غیرمستقیم ۱، مستقیم ۲؛ قوه‌ی مجریه: منصوب مرکز ۰، دوگانه ۱، برگزیده‌ی مجلس یا انتخاب مستقیم ۲ (جمع)

scale: half a point each, up to 2: regions are the unit of representation in a national chamber; regional governments designate its members; regions hold a majority in it; that chamber has extensive legislative authority; regions are consulted on laws that affect them; they have a veto over such laws
scale_fa: هر یک نیم امتیاز، تا ۲: مناطق واحد نمایندگی در یک مجلس ملی‌اند؛ حکومت‌های منطقه‌ای اعضایش را برمی‌گزینند؛ مناطق در آن اکثریت دارند؛ آن مجلس اختیار گسترده‌ی قانون‌گذاری دارد؛ با مناطق درباره‌ی قانون‌هایی که بر آن‌ها اثر دارد مشورت می‌شود؛ بر این قانون‌ها حق وتو دارند

scale: no routine meetings between central and regional governments
routine meetings without binding authority
routine meetings with binding authority
scale_fa: نشست منظم میان حکومت مرکزی و منطقه‌ای نیست
نشست منظم بی‌اختیار الزام‌آور
نشست منظم با اختیار الزام‌آور

they have a veto

حق وتو دارند

they negotiate them with a veto

بی‌حق وتو مذاکره می‌کنند
با حق وتو مذاکره می‌کنند

حکومت‌های منطقه‌ای یا نمایندگانشان حق وتو دارند

abide.d: Requires citizens or public officers to obey the constitution. This primarily applies to individuals in cases where the constitution includes a statement of the duties of citizens or holders of public office.
abide.df: شهروندان یا مقام‌های عمومی باید از قانون اساسی پیروی کنند.
abide.q: Does the constitution refer to a duty for holders of public office or the people to obey, or to abide by, the constitution?

access.d: Allows the state to incorporate new territory into the country. Usually also specifies the necessary steps for this to happen.
access.df: به کشور اجازه‌ی الحاق سرزمین تازه می‌دهد و معمولن گام‌های لازم را هم تعیین می‌کند.
access.q: Does the constitution provide for accession or adoption of territory outside of the country into the constitutional regime?

acfree.d: Allows scholars to pursue their research agenda without undue interference from the state. This is usually understood to also include freedom to teach and publish.
acfree.df: پژوهش‌گران بی‌دخالت ناروای دولت پژوهش می‌کنند؛ معمولن آزادی تدریس و انتشار را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
acfree.q: Does the constitution guarantee academic freedom?

achighed.d: Guarantees individuals equal access to higher education. In some cases this may be limited on a competitive basis, or by tests of aptitude.
achighed.df: دسترسی برابر به آموزش عالی، که گاه با رقابت یا آزمون استعداد محدود می‌شود.
achighed.q: Does the constitution guarantee equal access to higher education?

adage.d: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained before assuming the office of judge in an administrative court. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
adage.df: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن برای تصدی قضاوت در دادگاه اداری و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.
adage.q: What is the minimum age limit for eligibility to serve as a member of administrative courts?

adres.fa: شرایط احراز قضاوت در دادگاه اداری
adres.d: Conditions that an individual must fulfil in order to serve as a judge in an administrative court. These often concern educational and professional credentials.
adres.df: شرایطی که قاضی دادگاه اداری باید داشته باشد، اغلب درباره‌ی تحصیلات و سابقه‌ی حرفه‌ای.
adres.q: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on the eligibility to serve as a member of administrative courts?

adsel.d: The procedure through which a candidate for an administrative judgeship is nominated and approved. This might involve approval from the executive, and all or part of the legislature.
adsel.df: روال نامزدی و تایید قاضی دادگاه اداری، که ممکن است به تایید قوه‌ی مجریه و همه یا بخشی از مجلس نیاز داشته باشد.
adsel.q: Who is involved in the nomination of judges to administrative courts?

adterm.d: The number of years that an administrative judge serves before either reappointment or dismissal is required.
adterm.df: شمار سال‌های خدمت قاضی دادگاه اداری پیش از انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری.
adterm.q: What is the maximum term length for judges for administrative courts?

adtermn.d: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve as a judge in an administrative court.
adtermn.df: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند قاضی دادگاه اداری باشد.
adtermn.q: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms judges on the administrative court may serve?

amend.d: Details the way in which the text of the constitution can be formally amended. This is distinct from the task of constitutional interpretation often undertaken by courts.
amend.df: شیوه‌ی رسمی تغییر متن قانون اساسی، جدا از تفسیر قانون اساسی که اغلب کار دادگاه‌هاست.
amend.q: Does the constitution provide for at least one procedure for amending the constitution?

amparo.d: Gives citizens the right to request judicial review of government actions or judgments that they believe have violated their rights.
amparo.df: حق شهروندان برای درخواست بازبینی قضایی کارها یا احکام حکومتی که به گمانشان حقوقشان را نقض کرده است.
amparo.q: Does the constitution provide for a right to petition for 'amparo'?

anthem.d: Names the official anthem of the state.
anthem.df: سرود رسمی کشور را نام می‌برد.
anthem.q: Does the constitution contain provisions concerning the national anthem?

appeal.d: Gives individuals the right to appeal a judicial decision in a higher court if they are not satisfied with the outcome in the court of first instance. Does not necessarily require the appellate court to hear the case, but the mention of an appellate court may imply the power to appeal.
appeal.df: حق درخواست تجدیدنظر از رای دادگاه بدوی در دادگاهی بالاتر.
appeal.q: Does the constitution mention the right to appeal ordinary court decisions to a higher court?

arms.d: Grants individuals the right to possess firearms and other weapons. This right may in some jurisdictions still be subject to regulation of the kinds of weapons that can be possessed, and the places and manners in which they may be transported.
arms.df: حق افراد برای داشتن سلاح گرم و جنگ‌افزارهای دیگر؛ این حق ممکن است همچنان تابع مقررات مربوط به نوع سلاح و جا و شیوه‌ی حمل آن باشد.
arms.q: Does the constitution provide for the right to bear arms?

artists.d: References to art or artists indicate the importance of art to the national identity, and are often made in the context of mandating state support for the arts.
artists.df: اشاره به هنر یا هنرمندان به‌عنوان بخشی از هویت ملی، اغلب برای الزام دولت به پشتیبانی از هنر.
artists.q: Does the constitution refer to artists or the arts?

assem.d: Grants individuals the right to gather in groups, in public spaces, for any otherwise legal purpose. This is right is closely associated with the idea of protest.
assem.df: حق گردهم‌آیی در مکان‌های عمومی برای هر هدف قانونی، که پیوند نزدیکی با حق اعتراض دارد.
assem.q: Does the constitution provide for freedom of assembly?

assets.d: Requires legislators to disclose their income, or the value of their assets. This disclosure is typically made to a specified official or commission, and is not necessarily made public.
assets.df: نمایندگان باید درآمد یا ارزش دارایی خود را به مقام یا کمیسیونی معین اعلام کنند؛ این اعلام لزومن علنی نیست.
assets.q: Does the constitution require that legislators disclose their earnings and/or assets?

assoc.d: Grants individuals the right to form groups or associations for any otherwise legal purpose. This also sometimes includes the right not to join or associate with a group.
assoc.df: حق تشکیل گروه یا انجمن برای هر هدف قانونی، و گاه حق نپیوستن به گروهی.
assoc.q: Does the constitution provide for freedom of association?

asylum.d: Requires the state to offer its protection to one or more of the following vulnerable groups: stateless persons, asylum seekers, or refugees.
asylum.df: دولت باید از بی‌تابعیتان، پناه‌جویان یا پناهندگان حمایت کند.
asylum.q: Does the constitution contain provisions for the protection of stateless individuals, refugees from other states, or the right to asylum?

atgen.d: The office responsible for representing the government in criminal or civil cases. The office may have various names, including the public prosecutor, or prosecutor general.
atgen.df: مقامی که در دعاوی کیفری یا مدنی نماینده‌ی حکومت است، با نام‌هایی مانند دادستان عمومی یا دادستان کل.
atgen.q: Does the constitution provide for an attorney general or public prosecutor responsible for representing the government in criminal or civil cases?

attend.d: Requires legislators to attend sessions or votes. Examples include mandatory attendance, punishment after a specified number of absences, or delegating the matter to ordinary law.
attend.df: نمایندگان را به حضور در جلسه‌ها یا رای‌گیری‌ها ملزم می‌کند، مثلن با حضور اجباری، مجازات پس از شمار معینی غیبت یا واگذاری موضوع به قانون عادی.
attend.q: What provisions does the constitution make regarding attendance by legislators?

auth.d: Establishes the agent with the authority to install the constitution or from which the state derives its ultimate authority. Many constitutions invoke the people, an assembly, a group of subnational units, a monarch, or a deity.
auth.df: تعیین می‌کند قانون اساسی را چه کسی برقرار کرده است یا اقتدار نهایی کشور از کجا سرچشمه می‌گیرد: مردم، یک مجلس، واحدهای زیرملی، پادشاه یا خدا.
auth.q: Whose authority is the constitution said to be established?

balbudgt.d: A requirement that the government pass a budget in which incoming revenue meets or exceeds the value of the government's expenditures in a fiscal year.
balbudgt.df: الزام به تصویب بودجه‌ای که درآمدهایش دست‌کم برابر هزینه‌های سال مالی باشد.
balbudgt.q: Does the constitution specify that the budget must be balanced?

bank.d: Establishes or affirms a central bank. May also include requirements for its governance and operations.
bank.df: بانک مرکزی را برپا یا تایید می‌کند و گاه قواعد اداره و کار آن را هم می‌آورد.
bank.q: Does the constitution contain provisions for a central bank?

binding.d: Establishes whether or not the rights listed in the constitution are binding on private individuals as well as the state.
binding.df: تعیین می‌کند که آیا حقوق برشمرده در قانون اساسی افزون بر دولت، اشخاص خصوصی را هم ملزم می‌کند یا نه.
binding.q: Are rights provisions binding on private parties as well as the state?

budget.d: Special legislative processes for budget bills, which may include restrictions on proposal, approval, or amendment. Budget bills refer to legislation that lays out the revenues and expenditures for some period of time, usually in years.
budget.df: روال ویژه‌ی قانون‌گذاری برای لایحه‌ی بودجه، که درآمدها و هزینه‌های دوره‌ای معین، معمولن یک‌ساله، را تعیین می‌کند.

busines.d: Grants individuals the right to establish for-profit commercial endeavors.
busines.df: حق افراد برای راه‌اندازی فعالیت تجاری سودآور.
busines.q: Does the constitution provide a right to conduct/establish a business?

cabdiss.d: Cabinet members generally serve at the pleasure of the appointing power, typically the executive. Many constitutions also allow the legislative branch to remove cabinet members in cases of misconduct.
cabdiss.df: وزیران معمولن تا وقتی مقام منصوب‌کننده بخواهد می‌مانند؛ بسیاری از قانون‌های اساسی به مجلس هم اجازه‌ی برکناری وزیران خطاکار را می‌دهند.
cabdiss.q: Is the cabinet/ministers collectively responsible for their actions, or can they be dismissed individually?

cabinet.d: The body of high ranking officials who act as the heads of government departments and advise the head of state or head of government.
cabinet.df: مقام‌های بلندپایه‌ای که در راس وزارتخانه‌ها هستند و رئیس کشور یا رئیس دولت را مشورت می‌دهند.
cabinet.q: Does the constitution mention the executive cabinet/ministers?

cabpow.d: Matters on which the executive’s ministers have the power to act. These powers are often expressed in very general terms, but in some cases additional powers are enumerated for exercise in particular contexts.
cabpow.df: اموری که وزیران در آن‌ها اختیار عمل دارند؛ اغلب کلی بیان می‌شود و گاه اختیاراتی ویژه برای موقعیت‌های معین برشمرده می‌شود.
cabpow.q: What specific powers are granted to the cabinet?

cabrest.d: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve in the cabinet. This is sometimes as simple as eligibility to vote, but may include a number of requirements. Ministers may also be restricted from serving as legislators.
cabrest.df: شرایطی که وزیر باید داشته باشد، از داشتن حق رای تا شرایطی بیش‌تر؛ گاه وزیران از نمایندگی مجلس منع می‌شوند.
cabrest.q: What is the minimum age limit for eligibility to serve as a member of the cabinet?

cabsel.d: Establishes the bodies competent to nominate and approve members of the cabinet. Appointment is usually made by the executive branch, and is in some cases subject to approval by the legislative branch.
cabsel.df: نهادهایی که وزیران را نامزد و تایید می‌کنند؛ انتصاب معمولن با قوه‌ی مجریه است و گاه به تایید مجلس نیاز دارد.

camppubf.d: Rules that political parties and candidates must follow in financing electoral campaigns. Some constitutions establish government assistance for such purposes, or forbid receipt of funds from certain other sources.
camppubf.df: قواعد تامین مالی تبلیغات احزاب و نامزدها؛ برخی قانون‌های اساسی کمک دولتی می‌دهند یا دریافت پول از منابعی معین را منع می‌کنند.
camppubf.q: Are there any provisions for the public financing of campaigns?

capital.d: Names the capital city of the state.
capital.q: Does the constitution contain provisions specifying the location of the capital (if so, please specify the location in the comments section)?

cappun.d: Forbids the state from employing the death penalty as a punishment for any crime.
cappun.df: دولت نمی‌تواند برای هیچ جرمی اعدام کند.
cappun.q: How does the constitution treat the use of capital punishment?

cc.d: An independent commission specifically empowered to investigate corruption within the government.
cc.df: کمیسیونی مستقل با اختیار ویژه‌ی تحقیق درباره‌ی فساد در حکومت.
cc.q: Does the constitution contain provisions for a counter corruption commission?

census.d: Provides for the enumeration of residents periodically. Additional instructions about the conduct of the census may also be given.
census.df: سرشماری دوره‌ای ساکنان، گاه با دستورهایی درباره‌ی شیوه‌ی انجام آن.
census.q: Does the constitution specify a census?

childpro.d: Children are guaranteed certain rights or afforded special protections, which may include state-provided education and healthcare, and/or the right to be free from any kind of abuse.
childpro.df: تضمین حقوق یا حمایت‌های ویژه برای کودکان، از جمله آموزش و درمان از سوی دولت یا مصونیت از هر گونه آزار.
childpro.q: Does the constitution guarantee the rights of children?

childwrk.d: Protects children against exploitation in the workplace. This may be in the form of a ban on child workers, or as a requirement for additional protections for child workers.
childwrk.df: حمایت از کودکان در برابر بهره‌کشی در کار، با منع کار کودک یا حمایت بیش‌تر از کودکان کار.
childwrk.q: Does the constitution place limits on child employment?

citdep.d: In extraordinary circumstances, usually relating to criminal convictions abroad, some constitutions give the government the power to deport citizens. In other constitutions, the government is specifically prohibited from deporting citizens but allows deportation of other residents.
citdep.df: برخی قانون‌های اساسی در شرایط استثنایی، معمولن پس از محکومیت کیفری در خارج، اخراج شهروند را مجاز می‌دانند و برخی آن را منع می‌کنند و تنها اخراج غیرشهروندان را مجاز می‌شمارند.
citdep.q: Does the constitution grant the government the right to deport citizens or residents?

citizen.d: Details the requirements for an individual to be granted citizenship at birth. The requirements may relate to the citizenship or residency of one or both parents, or to the location of an individual's birth.
citizen.df: شرایط اعطای تابعیت هنگام تولد، بر پایه‌ی تابعیت یا اقامت یک یا هر دو والد یا محل تولد.
citizen.q: Does the constitution refer to nationals, subjects, or citizens?

citren.d: Grants individuals the right to renounce their citizenship. This right is sometimes subject to qualifications relating to dual-citizenship, or the existence of a state of war.
citren.df: حق افراد برای ترک تابعیت خود، گاه با قیدهایی درباره‌ی تابعیت دوگانه یا زمان جنگ.
citren.q: Do citizens have the right to renounce their citizenship?

citrev.d: Describes the conditions under which a government is allowed to revoke an individual's citizenship. Some constitutions expressly forbid the government from revoking citizenship, regardless of the circumstances.
citrev.df: شرایطی که حکومت در آن می‌تواند تابعیت فرد را سلب کند؛ برخی قانون‌های اساسی سلب تابعیت را در هر شرایطی منع می‌کنند.
citrev.q: Under what conditions can citizenship be revoked?

civil.d: Requires that officials in the public service are recruited and promoted on the basis of merit. This is intended to be a hedge against patronage and nepotism, and may require standardized exams or a specified kind of credential.
civil.df: کارکنان دولت باید بر پایه‌ی شایستگی استخدام و ارتقا یابند، برای جلوگیری از حامی‌پروری و خویشاوندسالاری، گاه با آزمون یا مدرکی معین.
civil.q: Does the constitution include provisions for the meritocratic recruitment of civil servants (e.g. exams or credential requirements)?

civilmil.d: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as the minister of defense. Particularly concerned with whether the minister is required to be, or prohibited from being, a member of the military.
civilmil.df: شرایط تصدی وزارت دفاع، به‌ویژه این‌که وزیر باید نظامی باشد یا نباید باشد.
civilmil.q: Are there any restrictions on the minister of defense?

civmar.d: Recognizes secular marriages performed by a government official or other so empowered individuals, or religious marriages that also involve a license from the state.
civmar.df: به‌رسمیت شناختن ازدواج غیردینی که مامور دولت یا شخص مجاز ثبت می‌کند، یا ازدواج دینی که به مجوز دولت هم نیاز دارد.
civmar.q: Is there a constitutional provision for civil marriage?

colony.d: Mention of territory beyond the national borders that is under the government's control. This may include colonies, protectorates, or territories.
colony.df: اشاره به سرزمین‌هایی بیرون از مرزهای کشور که زیر کنترل حکومت‌اند، مانند مستعمره‌ها یا سرزمین‌های تحت‌الحمایه.
colony.q: How does the Constitution treat the status of colonies, protectorates, and territories?

comchief.d: Establishes ultimate control of the state's armed forces. Usually the head of state or head of government. This may be a ceremonial role, or may involve significant decision-making power.
comchief.df: تعیین فرمانده‌ی کل نیروهای مسلح، معمولن رئیس کشور یا رئیس دولت؛ این نقش ممکن است تشریفاتی باشد یا با اختیار واقعی تصمیم‌گیری همراه باشد.
comchief.q: Who is the commander in chief of the armed forces?

commit.d: The constitution establishes the existence of legislative committees.  Sometimes details on formation and procedure are provided.
commit.df: وجود کمیسیون‌های قانون‌گذاری را مقرر می‌کند و گاه جزئیات تشکیل و روال کارشان را هم می‌آورد.
commit.q: Are legislative committees mentioned in the constitution?

compvote.d: Makes voting mandatory for at least some electors in some elections. This is sometimes qualified on the basis of age, for example after age eighteen, or until age 70.
compvote.df: رای دادن را برای دست‌کم برخی رای‌دهندگان در برخی انتخابات الزامی می‌کند، گاه با قید سن.
compvote.q: Does the constitution make voting mandatory, at least for some elections?

conage.en: Age restrictions on constitutional court judges
conage.fa: محدودیت سنی قضات دادگاه قانون اساسی
conage.d: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained before assuming the office of judge in a constitutional court. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
conage.df: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن برای تصدی قضاوت در دادگاه قانون اساسی و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.
conage.q: What is the minimum age limit for eligibility to serve as a member of the constitutional court?

concop.d: Determines procedures for, or treatment of, judicial opinions handed down by the constitutional court.
concop.df: روال صدور یا جایگاه آرای دادگاه قانون اساسی را تعیین می‌کند.
concop.q: Does the constitution mention judicial opinions of the constitutional court?

conlim.fa: محدودیت دوره‌های قضات دادگاه قانون اساسی
conlim.d: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve as a judge in a constitutional court.
conlim.df: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند قاضی دادگاه قانون اساسی باشد.
conlim.q: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms judges on the constitutional court may serve?

conpow.d: Establishes the competencies of the constitutional court, other than adjudication and review of legislation. Such powers may include supervision of elections, impeachment of the executive, review of treaties, or other specified functions.
conpow.df: صلاحیت‌های دادگاه قانون اساسی جز دادرسی و بازبینی قوانین، مانند نظارت بر انتخابات، محاکمه‌ی مقام‌های اجرایی یا بازبینی معاهده‌ها.
conpow.q: What additional powers does the constitutional court have besides reviewing legislation?

conrem.d: In cases where a judge has committed a crime, or otherwise compromised the integrity of their office, he or she may be removed from office. This may be carried out by the legislature, the executive, or another competent body.
conrem.df: برکناری قاضی‌ای که جرمی مرتکب شده یا درستکاری منصبش را خدشه‌دار کرده است، به دست مجلس، قوه‌ی مجریه یا نهادی صلاحیت‌دار.
conrem.q: Does the constitution mention any special procedures for removing members of the constitutional court?

conres.fa: شرایط احراز قضاوت در دادگاه قانون اساسی
conres.d: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as a judge in a constitutional court. These often concern educational and professional credentials.
conres.df: شرایطی که قاضی دادگاه قانون اساسی باید داشته باشد، اغلب درباره‌ی تحصیلات و سابقه‌ی حرفه‌ای.
conres.q: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on the eligibility to serve as a member of the constitutional court?

conright.d: Addresses consumer rights or consumer protection. Protects consumers from harmful products and/or predatory or unethical business practices.
conright.df: حقوق مصرف‌کننده و حمایت از او در برابر کالاهای زیان‌بار یا رفتار غارت‌گرانه یا غیراخلاقی بنگاه‌ها.
conright.q: Does the constitution mention consumer rights or consumer protection?

consel.fa: شیوه‌ی گزینش قضات دادگاه قانون اساسی
consel.d: The procedure through which a candidate for a constitutional court judgeship is nominated and approved.  This might involve approval from the executive, and all or part of the legislature.
consel.df: روال نامزدی و تایید قاضی دادگاه قانون اساسی، که ممکن است به تایید قوه‌ی مجریه و همه یا بخشی از مجلس نیاز داشته باشد.
consel.q: Who is involved in the nomination of judges to the constitutional court?

conterm.fa: مدت دوره‌ی قضات دادگاه قانون اساسی
conterm.d: The number of years that a constitutional court judge serves before either reappointment or dismissal is required.
conterm.df: شمار سال‌های خدمت قاضی دادگاه قانون اساسی پیش از انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری.
conterm.q: What is the maximum term length for judges for the constitutional court?

corppun.d: Forbids the state from inflicting physical harm on an offender as a punishment for any crime.
corppun.df: دولت نمی‌تواند به‌عنوان مجازات به بدن مجرم آسیب برساند.
corppun.q: How does the constitution treat the use of corporal punishment?

couns.d: Gives individuals who have been arrested the right to legal counsel. In absence of a right to counsel some constitutions grant only the right to a defense.
couns.df: حق بازداشت‌شدگان به داشتن وکیل؛ برخی قانون‌های اساسی تنها حق دفاع را می‌آورند.
couns.q: Does the constitution provide the right to counsel if one is indicted or arrested?

cruelty.d: Forbids the state from treating individuals in a way that offends the principle of human dignity. This may include forms of corporal or capital punishment, excessive delays in assessing punishment, or other actions prejudicial to the rights of offenders.
cruelty.df: دولت نمی‌تواند با افراد رفتاری مغایر کرامت انسانی داشته باشد، از جمله برخی مجازات‌های بدنی یا اعدام، تاخیر بیش از حد در تعیین مجازات یا دیگر کارهای زیان‌بار به حقوق محکومان.
cruelty.q: Does the constitution prohibit cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment?

cultrght.d: Establishes the right of individuals to practice their culture. May also require the state to protect or promote cultural rights.
cultrght.df: حق افراد برای زیستن با فرهنگ خود؛ ممکن است دولت را به حمایت یا ترویج حقوق فرهنگی هم ملزم کند.
cultrght.q: Are any of the following political rights or benefits specifically granted to indigenous groups?

custlaw.d: Reference to customary international law, the law of nations, or the generally accepted principles of international law.
custlaw.df: اشاره به حقوق بین‌الملل عرفی، حقوق ملل یا اصول پذیرفته‌شده‌ی حقوق بین‌الملل.
custlaw.q: Does the constitution refer to 'customary' international law or the 'law of nations'?

debtors.d: Protection for individuals who are unable to repay loans or other financial obligations. The contractual rights of the lender are qualified by the right of the debtor to their freedom or dignity.
debtors.df: حمایت از کسانی که توان بازپرداخت وام یا تعهد مالی ندارند؛ حق طلبکار با حق بدهکار بر آزادی و کرامتش محدود می‌شود.
debtors.q: Does the constitution forbid the detention of debtors?

depexec.d: Specification of the deputy to the head of state or head of government. The deputy executive typically has the power to act when the executive is absent or becomes incapable of holding office.
depexec.df: جانشین رئیس کشور یا رئیس دولت، که معمولن در غیاب یا ناتوانی او اختیار عمل دارد.
depexec.q: Does the constitution specify a deputy executive of any kind (e.g., deputy prime minister, vice president)?

devlpers.d: Grants individuals the right to both develop and express their own unique personality.
devlpers.df: حق هر فرد برای پروراندن و ابراز شخصیت ویژه‌ی خود.
devlpers.q: Does the constitution provide for an individual's right to self determination or the right to free development of personality?

dignity.d: Considered one of the fundamental values of many states. Often mentioned in the preamble as a motivation for the constitution. Also a justification for some constitutional provisions.
dignity.df: از ارزش‌های بنیادین بسیاری از کشورها که اغلب در مقدمه به‌عنوان انگیزه‌ی قانون اساسی و گاه در توجیه برخی اصول آن می‌آید.
dignity.q: Does the constitution refer to the 'dignity of man' or human 'dignity'?

district.d: Describes characteristics, or rules for the establishment, of electoral districts. Constitutions rarely directly establish the districts, but rather describe where and how these decisions will be made.
district.df: ویژگی‌ها یا قواعد تعیین حوزه‌های انتخابیه؛ قانون اساسی به‌ندرت خود حوزه‌ها را تعیین می‌کند و بیش‌تر می‌گوید این تصمیم کجا و چگونه گرفته شود.
district.q: Who controls the size and shape of electoral districts?

divhouse.d: Specifies the manner in which the work of the legislative process is divided between the two chambers of the legislature. For example, legislation could be considered concurrently or sequentially, or could be divided on the basis of policy areas.
divhouse.df: شیوه‌ی تقسیم کار قانون‌گذاری میان دو مجلس را تعیین می‌کند، مثلن بررسی هم‌زمان یا پیاپی، یا تقسیم بر پایه‌ی حوزه‌های سیاستی.
divhouse.q: Which of the following characterizes the division of labor between the houses for general legislation?

doubjep.fa: منع محاکمه‌ی دوباره برای یک جرم
doubjep.d: Prohibits the state from charging an individual with an offense for which they have already been acquitted. This does not necessarily prevent the prosecution from appealing an acquittal.
doubjep.df: دولت نمی‌تواند کسی را برای جرمی که از آن تبرئه شده است دوباره متهم کند؛ این لزومن تجدیدنظرخواهی دادستان را منع نمی‌کند.
doubjep.q: Does the constitution provide for the prohibition of double jeopardy (i.e., being tried for the same crime twice)?

dueproc.d: Ensures that defendants in criminal trials are entitled to have their cases heard according to the process established by law. This may include specific rights, such as the right to be informed of the charges, the right to counsel, and the right to appeal.
dueproc.df: رسیدگی به اتهام کیفری باید طبق روال قانونی باشد، از جمله حق آگاهی از اتهام، داشتن وکیل و تجدیدنظرخواهی.
dueproc.q: Does the constitution explicitly mention due process?

ecage.en: Age restrictions on electoral court judges
ecage.d: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained before assuming the office of judge in an electoral court. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
ecage.df: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن برای تصدی قضاوت در دادگاه انتخاباتی و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.
ecage.q: What is the minimum age limit for eligibility to serve as a member of the electoral court?

ecom.d: An independent commission responsible for facilitating and regulating elections. May be responsible for monitoring political parties and the financing of elections.
ecom.df: کمیسیونی مستقل برای برگزاری و نظارت بر انتخابات، که ممکن است بر احزاب و تامین مالی انتخابات هم نظارت کند.
ecom.q: What are the details of the procedure for selecting members for the electoral commission?

econplan.d: Mention of national economic plans, possibly with the procedure for establishing them. Such procedures may include special rules for proposal, approval, or amendment.
econplan.df: اشاره به برنامه‌های اقتصادی ملی و گاه روال تهیه، تصویب یا اصلاح آن‌ها.
econplan.q: Does the constitution mention the adoption of national economic plans?

ecpow.d: Establishes the competencies of the electoral court. In addition to hearing challenges of election results, the court may be responsible for certifying various aspects of elections, including voter rolls and final vote tallies.
ecpow.df: صلاحیت‌های دادگاه انتخاباتی: افزون بر رسیدگی به اعتراض به نتایج، گاه تایید فهرست رای‌دهندگان و شمارش نهایی آرا.
ecpow.q: What powers are explicitly granted to the electoral court?

ecrdet.d: In cases where a judge has committed a crime, or otherwise compromised the integrity of their office, he or she may be removed from office. This may be carried out by the legislature, the executive, or another competent body.
ecrdet.df: برکناری قاضی‌ای که جرمی مرتکب شده یا درستکاری منصبش را خدشه‌دار کرده است، به دست مجلس، قوه‌ی مجریه یا نهادی صلاحیت‌دار.
ecrdet.q: What are the procedures for the removal of members of the electoral court?

ecres.fa: شرایط احراز قضاوت در دادگاه انتخاباتی
ecres.d: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as a judge in an electoral court. These often concern educational and professional credentials.
ecres.df: شرایطی که قاضی دادگاه انتخاباتی باید داشته باشد، اغلب درباره‌ی تحصیلات و سابقه‌ی حرفه‌ای.
ecres.q: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on the eligibility to serve as a member of the electoral court?

ecsel.d: The procedure through which a candidate for an electoral court judgeship is nominated and approved.  This might involve approval from the executive, and all or part of the legislature.
ecsel.df: روال نامزدی و تایید قاضی دادگاه انتخاباتی، که ممکن است به تایید قوه‌ی مجریه و همه یا بخشی از مجلس نیاز داشته باشد.
ecsel.q: Who is involved in the nomination of judges to the electoral court?

ecterm.d: The number of years that an electoral judge serves before either reappointment or dismissal is required.
ecterm.df: شمار سال‌های خدمت قاضی دادگاه انتخاباتی پیش از انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری.
ecterm.q: What is the maximum term length for judges for the electoral court?

ecterml.d: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve as a judge in an electoral court.
ecterml.df: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند قاضی دادگاه انتخاباتی باشد.
ecterml.q: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms judges on the electoral court may serve?

edcomp.d: Requires children to attend school. This may be a requirement up to a certain age, or to a certain level of educational attainment.
edcomp.df: کودکان باید تا سن یا مقطعی معین به مدرسه بروند.
edcomp.q: Does the constitution stipulate that education be compulsory until at least some level?

edfree.d: Requires the state to provide education free of charge. This may be limited at a certain age or level of educational attainment.
edfree.df: دولت باید آموزش رایگان فراهم کند، گاه تا سن یا مقطعی معین.
edfree.q: Does the constitution stipulate that education be free, at least up to some level?

electsch.d: When elections shall be held. This could be described in terms of a particular day, an interval between elections, or with relation to the dismissal of the legislature or executive.
electsch.df: زمان برگزاری انتخابات: روزی معین، فاصله‌ای میان دو انتخابات، یا در پیوند با انحلال مجلس یا قوه‌ی مجریه.
electsch.q: What are the arrangements for the scheduling of elections?

em.d: Allows the government to declare an exceptional state, such as emergency, siege, or martial law. Usually gives the government additional powers, and may suspend some normal functions of the political system.
em.df: به حکومت اجازه‌ی اعلام وضعیت استثنایی، مانند وضعیت اضطراری، محاصره یا حکومت نظامی، را می‌دهد؛ معمولن اختیارات بیش‌تری می‌دهد و ممکن است برخی کارکردهای عادی نظام سیاسی را معلق کند.
em.q: Does the constitution have provisions for calling a state of emergency?

env.d: Imposes a duty on the state or on the people to protect or conserve the environment. This may also accord to citizens the right to enjoy a healthy environment.
env.df: دولت یا مردم وظیفه‌ی حفاظت از محیط زیست دارند؛ گاه شهروندان حق برخورداری از محیط زیست سالم هم دارند.
env.q: Does the constitution refer to protection or preservation of the environment?

equal.d: Guarantees that all individuals are entitled to the same privileges and immunities. Prohibits favoritism or discrimination to any group. All are considered to be equal before the law.
equal.df: همه از امتیازها و مصونیت‌های یکسان برخوردارند، هیچ گروهی بر گروه دیگر برتری ندارد یا تبعیض نمی‌بیند و همه در برابر قانون برابرند.
equal.q: Does the constitution refer to equality before the law, the equal rights of men, or non-discrimination?

equalgr1.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their gender or sex. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr1.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به جنس یا جنسیت؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr1.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr10.fa: برابری بدون توجه به رنگ پوست
equalgr10.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their skin color. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr10.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به رنگ پوست؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr10.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr11.en: Equality regardless of creed or belief
equalgr11.fa: برابری بدون توجه به عقیده و باور
equalgr11.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their creed, belief, or opinions. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr11.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به مسلک، باور یا عقیده؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr11.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr12.fa: برابری بدون توجه به جایگاه اجتماعی
equalgr12.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their social status or origin. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr12.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به جایگاه یا خاستگاه اجتماعی؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr12.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr13.fa: برابری بدون توجه به وضع مالی
equalgr13.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their financial status or property ownership. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr13.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به وضع مالی یا دارایی؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr13.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr14.en: Equality regardless of tribe or clan
equalgr14.fa: برابری بدون توجه به ایل و طایفه
equalgr14.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their tribe or clan. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr14.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به ایل یا طایفه؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr14.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr15.fa: برابری بدون توجه به وابستگی حزبی
equalgr15.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their political party membership or political opinions. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr15.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به عضویت حزبی یا عقیده‌ی سیاسی؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr15.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr16.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their parentage or birth. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr16.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به نسب یا تولد؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr16.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr2.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their nationality. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr2.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به تابعیت؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr2.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr3.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their country or place of origin. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr3.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به کشور یا زادگاه؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr3.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr4.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their race. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr4.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به نژاد؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr4.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr5.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their language. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr5.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به زبان؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr5.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr6.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their religion. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr6.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به دین؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr6.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr7.fa: برابری بدون توجه به گرایش جنسی
equalgr7.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their sexual orientation. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr7.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به گرایش جنسی؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr7.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr8.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to their age. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr8.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به سن؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr8.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

equalgr9.d: Requires that everyone is treated equally before the law, without regard to any disability. This may apply to both public and private interactions in some jurisdictions.
equalgr9.df: همه در برابر قانون برابرند، بدون توجه به معلولیت؛ در برخی نظام‌ها این برابری روابط خصوصی را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
equalgr9.q: Which of the following groups does the constitution protect from discrimination/provide for equality for (check all that apply)?

ethincl.d: Minority ethnic communities are enabled to participate in the affairs of the state or society. Some constitutions offer additional protection against forced assimilation.
ethincl.df: زمینه‌ی مشارکت اقلیت‌های قومی در امور کشور یا جامعه را فراهم می‌کند؛ برخی قانون‌های اساسی در برابر همگون‌سازی اجباری هم حمایت بیش‌تری می‌دهند.
ethincl.q: Does the constitution contain provisions concerning national integration of ethnic communities?

evidence.d: Regulates the state's actions with regard to searches and seizures, particularly with regard to criminal investigations. May also prohibit the admission of involuntary confessions, or other suspect forms of evidence.
evidence.df: کارهای دولت در بازرسی و توقیف، به‌ویژه در تحقیقات کیفری، را تنظیم می‌کند و ممکن است پذیرش اقرار اجباری یا ادله‌ی مشکوک را منع کند.
evidence.q: Does the constitution regulate the collection of evidence?

examwit.fa: حق بررسی ادله و پرسش از شاهدان
examwit.d: Grants an accused offender, and their legal counsel, the right to cross-examine evidence or witnesses brought against them by the prosecution.
examwit.df: حق متهم و وکیلش برای بررسی ادله و پرسش از شاهدان دادستانی.
examwit.q: Does the constitution provide for the right to examine evidence or confront all witnesses?

excrim.d: Details the procedure that must be followed for the state to surrender an individual apprehended on its territory to the government of another state for criminal proceedings. Where permitted, this is usually further regulated through bi-lateral treaties.
excrim.df: روال تحویل فردی که در خاک کشور دستگیر شده است به کشوری دیگر برای دادرسی کیفری، که اغلب با معاهده‌های دوجانبه تنظیم می‌شود.
excrim.q: Does the constitution provide for the extradition of suspected or convicted criminals to other countries?

execindp.d: Closely related to the idea of separation of powers, this is a constitutional guarantee of the independence of the executive.
execindp.df: تضمین استقلال قوه‌ی مجریه در قانون اساسی، در پیوند نزدیک با اصل تفکیک قوا.
execindp.q: Does the constitution contain an explicit declaration regarding the independence of the central executive organ(s)?

execnum.d: Distinguishes the structure of the executive. Establishes the offices of head of state and/or head of government.
execnum.df: ساختار قوه‌ی مجریه را مشخص می‌کند و جایگاه رئیس کشور، رئیس دولت یا هر دو را برپا می‌کند.
execnum.q: What name does the constitution assign the head of government?

expost.en: Protection from ex post facto laws
expost.d: Protects individuals from prosecution for acts that were not criminal at the time that they were committed, or from changes in the penalties for acts.
expost.df: کسی برای کاری که هنگام انجامش جرم نبوده است پیگرد نمی‌شود و تغییر مجازات‌ها هم به گذشته تسری نمی‌یابد.
expost.q: Does the constitution prohibit punishment by laws enacted ex post facto?

express.d: Grants individuals the right to express their thoughts and feelings without prior censorship or other forms of governmental interference. This right is rarely absolute, and is often limited in cases of sedition, hate speech, or obscenity.
express.df: حق افراد برای بیان اندیشه و احساس خود بی‌سانسور پیشین و بی‌دخالت حکومت؛ این حق به‌ندرت مطلق است و اغلب در موارد تحریک به شورش، نفرت‌پراکنی یا هرزه‌نگاری محدود می‌شود.
express.q: Does the constitution provide for freedom of expression or speech?

exprop.d: Protects individuals and businesses from government confiscation of their property without proper compensation. The level of compensation may be variously specified as fair, full, appropriate, adequate, or otherwise.
exprop.df: حمایت از افراد و بنگاه‌ها در برابر مصادره‌ی دارایی بی‌پرداخت غرامت مناسب؛ میزان غرامت ممکن است عادلانه، کامل یا کافی خوانده شود.
exprop.q: Can the government expropriate private property under at least some conditions?

exsess.d: Establishes who has the authority to call an extraordinary session of the legislature, and in some cases what circumstances would allow them to take such action.
exsess.df: تعیین می‌کند چه کسی و در چه شرایطی می‌تواند مجلس را به جلسه‌ی فوق‌العاده فرا بخواند.
exsess.q: Who, if anybody, can convene an extraordinary session of the legislature or extend an ongoing session?

fairtri.d: Protects individuals from unfair procedures. Fair trials often require a public hearing within a reasonable time following the arrest, and judgment by a competent and impartial jury.
fairtri.df: حمایت در برابر روال ناعادلانه، که اغلب به معنای رسیدگی علنی در زمانی معقول پس از بازداشت و داوری دادگاهی صالح و بی‌طرف است.
fairtri.q: Does the constitution provide the right to a fair trial?

falseimp.d: Provides redress for individuals who have been confined or arrested without just cause, or have otherwise suffered from judicial error.
falseimp.df: جبران برای کسانی که بی‌دلیل بازداشت یا زندانی شده‌اند یا از اشتباه قضایی زیان دیده‌اند.
falseimp.q: Does the constitution provide for the right of some redress in the case of false imprisonment, arrest, or judicial error?

fedrev.fa: بازبینی قوانین واحدهای زیرملی به دست حکومت فدرال
fedrev.d: In federal countries, the power of the federal government to review legislation passed by the governments of the subnational units. Such review could be undertaken by a federal court or another part of the federal government.
fedrev.df: در کشورهای فدرال، اختیار حکومت فدرال، از راه دادگاه فدرال یا نهادی دیگر، برای بازبینی قوانین واحدهای زیرملی.
fedrev.q: Does the constitution contain provisions allowing review of the legislation of the constituent units in federations by federal judicial or other central government organs?

fedsep.fa: قوانین ملی در برابر قوانین زیرملی
fedsep.d: Establishes which level of government has supremacy on certain legislative matters or in cases where their laws are in conflict.
fedsep.df: تعیین می‌کند در کدام امور قانون‌گذاری، یا هنگام تعارض قوانین، کدام سطح حکومت برتری دارد.
fedsep.q: Which level of government has superior legal status in the case of conflict?

figures.fa: اشاره به شخصیت‌ها و اندیشمندان سیاسی
figures.d: Reference to historical figures or political theorists. Usually mentioned in the preamble in the context of a particular political tradition.
figures.df: یاد کردن از شخصیت‌های تاریخی یا نظریه‌پردازان سیاسی، معمولن در مقدمه و در پیوند با سنتی سیاسی.
figures.q: Are there any political figures/theorists/philosophers mentioned in the Constitution?

finance.d: Special legislative processes for finance bills, which may include restrictions on proposal, approval, or amendment. Finance bills refer to legislation specifically for the borrowing of money for governmental use, like loans from NGOs, other countries, or even private individuals.
finance.df: روال ویژه‌ی قانون‌گذاری برای استقراض دولت، مانند وام از سازمان‌ها، کشورهای دیگر یا اشخاص خصوصی.

finsup1.d: Obligates the state to provide financial or material resources to elderly persons.
finsup1.df: دولت باید به سالمندان منابع مالی یا مادی بدهد.
finsup1.q: Does the constitution provide for either general or financial support by the government for any of the following groups?

finsup2.d: Obligates the state to provide financial or material resources to unemployed persons.
finsup2.df: دولت باید به بیکاران منابع مالی یا مادی بدهد.
finsup2.q: Does the constitution provide for either general or financial support by the government for any of the following groups?

finsup3.fa: حمایت دولت از افراد دارای معلولیت
finsup3.d: Obligates the state to provide financial or material resources to persons with disabilities.
finsup3.df: دولت باید به افراد دارای معلولیت منابع مالی یا مادی بدهد.
finsup3.q: Does the constitution provide for either general or financial support by the government for any of the following groups?

finsup4.d: Obligates the state to provide financial or material resources to children.
finsup4.df: دولت باید به کودکان منابع مالی یا مادی بدهد.
finsup4.q: Does the constitution provide for either general or financial support by the government for any of the following groups?

flag.d: Describes the principal features of the national flag.
flag.df: ویژگی‌های اصلی پرچم کشور را وصف می‌کند.
flag.q: Does the constitution contain provisions concerning the national flag?

fndfam.d: Grants individuals the right to commit to one another and raise children together. This right is closely tied to the right to marry. Many constitutions stipulate only a general state duty to protect the family.
fndfam.df: حق افراد برای پیوند با یکدیگر و پرورش فرزند، که با حق ازدواج پیوند نزدیک دارد؛ بسیاری از قانون‌های اساسی تنها وظیفه‌ی کلی دولت در حمایت از خانواده را می‌آورند.
fndfam.q: Does the constitution provide the right to found a family?

freecomp.d: Protects individuals and businesses from monopolies, price fixing, and other means of reducing competition in the marketplace.
freecomp.df: حمایت از افراد و بنگاه‌ها در برابر انحصار، تبانی در قیمت و دیگر راه‌های کاستن از رقابت.
freecomp.q: Does the constitution provide the right to a free and/or competitive market?

freeelec.d: Voting takes place in such a way that a citizen completes the ballot privately, and the ballot cannot be connected to the voter.
freeelec.df: شهروند برگه‌ی رای را در خلوت پر می‌کند و برگه به رای‌دهنده ردیابی‌پذیر نیست.
freeelec.q: Does the constitution prescribe that electoral ballots be secret?

freemove.d: Grants citizens the right to travel and reside anywhere within the state, and to travel to and from other countries. The right does not normally grant non-citizens access to the state.
freemove.df: حق شهروندان برای سفر و اقامت در هر جای کشور و رفت‌وآمد به کشورهای دیگر؛ این حق معمولن به غیرشهروندان حق ورود نمی‌دهد.
freemove.q: Does the constitution provide for freedom of movement?

freerel.d: Grants individuals the right to hold religious beliefs, and to freely practice those religious beliefs. This right is also commonly understood to include the right to change one's religion, or to have no religion at all.
freerel.df: حق داشتن باور دینی و انجام آزادانه‌ی آیین آن، که معمولن حق تغییر دین یا نداشتن دین را هم در بر می‌گیرد.
freerel.q: Does the constitution provide for freedom of religion?

god.d: An invocation of the divine. Often found in the preamble, particularly in states with an established religion.
god.df: یاد کردن از امر الهی، اغلب در مقدمه و به‌ویژه در کشورهایی با دین رسمی.
god.q: Does the Constitution mention 'God' or any other Deities?

govmed.d: Describes the relationship between the state and the media. This may give the state control over all media, allow the state to operate some media, or prohibit the state from such activities.
govmed.df: رابطه‌ی دولت و رسانه‌ها: کنترل دولت بر همه‌ی رسانه‌ها، اداره‌ی برخی از آن‌ها، یا منع دولت از این کار.
govmed.q: How does the constitution address the state operation of print or electronic media?

habcorp.d: Protects individuals from arbitrary detention or improper arrests. Sometimes specified as a right to a writ of habeas corpus.
habcorp.df: حمایت در برابر بازداشت خودسرانه یا دستگیری نادرست، که گاه به‌صورت حق درخواست قرار احضار زندانی (Habeas corpus) بیان می‌شود.
habcorp.q: Does the constitution provide for the right to protection from unjustified restraint (habeas corpus)?

headforn.d: Indicates the government official or body authorized to speak for the state abroad. This function could be fulfilled by the head of state, or by another government official such as the foreign minister.
headforn.df: مقام یا نهادی که از سوی کشور در خارج سخن می‌گوید، مانند رئیس کشور یا وزیر امور خارجه.
headforn.q: Who is the representative of the state for foreign affairs?

health.d: Obligates the state to provide health care to its citizens, or provides individuals with the general right to health care.  In some cases, health care must be provided by the government free of charge.
health.df: دولت باید به شهروندان خدمات درمانی بدهد، یا افراد حق کلی برخورداری از درمان دارند؛ گاه این خدمات باید رایگان باشد.
health.q: Does the constitution mention a state duty to provide health care?

hocage.en: Age restrictions on supreme court judges
hocage.d: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained before assuming the office of judge on the supreme court. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
hocage.df: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن برای تصدی قضاوت در دیوان عالی و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.
hocage.q: What is the minimum age limit for eligibility to serve as a the chief justice of the highest ordinary court?

hocop.d: Determines procedures for, or treatment of, judicial opinions handed down by the supreme court.
hocop.df: روال صدور یا جایگاه آرای دیوان عالی را تعیین می‌کند.
hocop.q: Does the constitution provide for judicial opinions of the highest ordinary court?

hocres.fa: شرایط احراز قضاوت در دیوان عالی
hocres.d: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as a judge on the supreme court. These often concern educational and professional credentials.
hocres.df: شرایطی که قاضی دیوان عالی باید داشته باشد، اغلب درباره‌ی تحصیلات و سابقه‌ی حرفه‌ای.
hocres.q: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on the eligibility to serve as the chief justice of the highest ordinary court?

hocsel.d: The procedure through which a candidate for a supreme court judgeship is nominated and approved.  This might involve approval from the executive, and all or part of the legislature.
hocsel.df: روال نامزدی و تایید قاضی دیوان عالی، که ممکن است به تایید قوه‌ی مجریه و همه یا بخشی از مجلس نیاز داشته باشد.
hocsel.q: Is the selection process specified for the chief justice or the other justices of the highest ordinary court?

hocsize.d: Establishes the number of seats on the supreme court.
hocsize.df: شمار کرسی‌های دیوان عالی را تعیین می‌کند.

hocterm.d: The number of years that a supreme court justice serves before either reappointment or dismissal is required.
hocterm.df: شمار سال‌های خدمت قاضی دیوان عالی پیش از انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری.
hocterm.q: What is the maximum term length for the chief justice of the highest ordinary court?

hocterml.d: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve as a judge on the supreme court.
hocterml.df: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند قاضی دیوان عالی باشد.
hocterml.q: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms for the chief justice of the highest ordinary court?

hogage.en: Age restrictions on head of government
hogage.d: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained before assuming the office of head of government. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
hogage.df: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن برای تصدی ریاست دولت و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.
hogage.q: What is the minimum age limit for becoming the head of government?

hogdec.d: Allows the head of government, or exceptionally the cabinet, to enact rules without following the usual channels for the passage of legislation. This power is usually limited to particular circumstances or areas of government activity.
hogdec.df: به رئیس دولت، یا به‌طور استثنایی هیات وزیران، اجازه می‌دهد بی‌گذر از روال عادی قانون‌گذاری مقررات وضع کند، معمولن در شرایط یا حوزه‌های معین.
hogdec.q: Does the head of government have decree power?

hogdiss.d: In cases where the head of government has committed a crime, or lost the confidence of the legislature, he or she may be removed from office. This may be carried out by the legislature, the head of state, or another competent body.
hogdiss.df: برکناری رئیس دولت در صورت ارتکاب جرم یا از دست دادن اعتماد مجلس، به دست مجلس، رئیس کشور یا نهادی صلاحیت‌دار.
hogdiss.q: Are there provisions for dismissing the head of government?

hogdlim.en: Limits on removing head of government
hogdlim.d: Protections from removal for the head of government. For example, a failed attempt to remove the head of government may preclude additional votes on the matter for a specified period of time.
hogdlim.df: حمایت از رئیس دولت در برابر برکناری؛ مثلن پس از استیضاحی ناکام، تا مدتی رای‌گیری دوباره ممنوع است.
hogdlim.q: In the case of a failed attempt to dismiss the head of government, are any limitations placed on future attempts to dismiss?

hogelect.d: The procedure through which a candidate for the office of head of government is nominated and approved. This typically involves approval from both the legislature and the head of state.
hogelect.df: روال نامزدی و تایید رئیس دولت، که معمولن به تایید مجلس و رئیس کشور نیاز دارد.
hogelect.q: How is the head of government selected?

hogimm.d: Protection, whether absolute or limited, against prosecution for the head of government. This may involve protection against prosecution for certain kinds of crimes, or for a specified period of time.
hogimm.df: مصونیت مطلق یا محدود رئیس دولت از پیگرد، برای برخی جرم‌ها یا برای مدتی معین.
hogimm.q: Is the head of government provided with immunity from prosecution?

hoglegr.en: Head of government's role in the legislature
hoglegr.d: Establishes whether the head of government is required to serve, or is prohibited from serving, as a member of the legislature.
hoglegr.df: تعیین می‌کند رئیس دولت باید نماینده‌ی مجلس باشد یا از آن منع می‌شود.
hoglegr.q: What restrictions does the constitution place on the head of government's role in the legislature?

hogpow.d: Specific, enumerated powers that are given to the head of government. For example, some heads of government are given the power to issue currency, grant asylum, award decorations, or various other particular powers.
hogpow.df: اختیارات مشخصی که به رئیس دولت داده می‌شود، مانند انتشار پول، اعطای پناهندگی یا اعطای نشان.
hogpow.q: What additional powers (i.e. powers not listed elsewhere in the survey) are given to the head of government?

hogrest.d: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as the head of government. This is sometimes as simple as eligibility to vote, but may include a number of requirements.
hogrest.df: شرایطی که رئیس دولت باید داشته باشد، از داشتن حق رای تا شرایطی بیش‌تر.
hogrest.q: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on becoming the head of government?

hogsucc.d: The procedure by which the head of government is replaced in the event that he or she does not complete his or her term. This might involve a predetermined succession, or reversion to the normal selection procedure.
hogsucc.df: روال جایگزینی رئیس دولتی که دوره‌اش را به پایان نمی‌برد: جانشینی از پیش تعیین‌شده یا بازگشت به روال عادی گزینش.
hogsucc.q: Should the head of government need to be replaced before the normally scheduled replacement process, what is the process of replacement?

hogterm.d: The number of years that a head of government serves before either reappointment or dismissal is required.
hogterm.df: شمار سال‌های خدمت رئیس دولت پیش از انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری.
hogterm.q: What is the maximum term length of the head of government?

hogterml.d: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve in the office of head of government.
hogterml.df: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند رئیس دولت باشد.
hogterml.q: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms the head of government may serve?

hosage.en: Age restrictions on head of state
hosage.d: Most commonly establishes the minimum age that an individual must have attained before assuming the office of head of state. In some cases may also provide a maximum age.
hosage.df: معمولن کمینه‌ی سن برای تصدی ریاست کشور و گاه بیشینه‌ی آن را تعیین می‌کند.
hosage.q: What is the minimum age limit for becoming the head of state?

hosdec.d: Allows the head of state to enact rules without following the usual channels for the passage of legislation. This power is usually limited to particular circumstances or areas of government activity.
hosdec.df: به رئیس کشور اجازه می‌دهد بی‌گذر از روال عادی قانون‌گذاری مقررات وضع کند، معمولن در شرایط یا حوزه‌های معین.
hosdec.q: Does the head of state have decree power?

hosdiss.d: In cases where the head of state has committed a crime, or lost the confidence of the legislature, he or she may be removed from office. This may be carried out by the legislature, the head of government, or another competent body.
hosdiss.df: برکناری رئیس کشور در صورت ارتکاب جرم یا از دست دادن اعتماد مجلس، به دست مجلس، رئیس دولت یا نهادی صلاحیت‌دار.
hosdiss.q: Who can approve a dismissal of the head of state?

hoselect.d: The procedure through which a candidate for the office of head of state is nominated and approved. While there is great variation, common procedures include heredity, direct election, or election by the legislature.
hoselect.df: روال نامزدی و تایید رئیس کشور؛ شیوه‌های رایج: وراثت، انتخاب مستقیم یا انتخاب به دست مجلس.
hoselect.q: How is the head of state selected?

hosimm.d: Protection, whether absolute or limited, against prosecution for the head of state. This may involve protection against prosecution for certain kinds of crimes, or for a specified period of time.
hosimm.df: مصونیت مطلق یا محدود رئیس کشور از پیگرد، برای برخی جرم‌ها یا برای مدتی معین.
hosimm.q: Is the head of state provided with immunity from prosecution?

hospow.d: Specific, enumerated powers that are given to the head of state. For example, some heads of state are given the power to issue currency, grant asylum, award decorations, or various other particular powers.
hospow.df: اختیارات مشخصی که به رئیس کشور داده می‌شود، مانند انتشار پول، اعطای پناهندگی یا اعطای نشان.
hospow.q: What additional powers (i.e. powers not listed elsewhere in the survey) are given to the head of state?

hosrest.d: Qualifications that an individual must meet in order to serve as the head of government. This is sometimes as simple as eligibility to vote, but may include a number of requirements.
hosrest.df: شرایطی که رئیس کشور باید داشته باشد، از داشتن حق رای تا شرایطی بیش‌تر.
hosrest.q: What additional restrictions does the constitution place on becoming the head of state?

hosstaff.en: Advisory bodies to the head of state
hosstaff.d: In addition to a cabinet, other councils of high ranking officials may advise the head of state. This could include a privy council to a monarch, for example. Some advisory bodies may consult on specific topics, such as national security.
hosstaff.df: افزون بر هیات وزیران، شوراهای دیگری از مقام‌های بلندپایه ممکن است رئیس کشور را مشورت دهند، مانند شورای مشورتی پادشاه یا شورایی برای امنیت ملی.
hosstaff.q: Does the constitution specify a council or advisory group (other than the cabinet)?  if so, what name is given to this body (enter name in comments)?

hossucc.d: The procedure by which the head of state is replaced in the event that he or she does not complete his or her term. This might involve a predetermined succession, or reversion to the normal selection procedure.
hossucc.df: روال جایگزینی رئیس کشوری که دوره‌اش را به پایان نمی‌برد: جانشینی از پیش تعیین‌شده یا بازگشت به روال عادی گزینش.
hossucc.q: Should the head of state need to be replaced before the normally scheduled replacement process, what is the process of replacement?

hosterm.d: The number of years that a head of state serves before either reappointment or dismissal is required.
hosterm.df: شمار سال‌های خدمت رئیس کشور پیش از انتصاب دوباره یا برکناری.
hosterm.q: What is the maximum term length of the head of state?

hosterml.d: The number of terms, either consecutive or in total, that an individual may serve in the office of head of state
hosterml.df: شمار دوره‌های پیاپی یا کل که یک نفر می‌تواند رئیس کشور باشد.
hosterml.q: What restrictions are in place regarding the number of terms the head of state may serve?

housenum.d: Establishes the number of chambers in the legislature.
housenum.df: شمار مجلس‌های قوه‌ی مقننه را تعیین می‌کند.
housenum.q: How many chambers or houses does the legislature contain?

hr.d: An independent commission tasked with investigating potential violations of human rights. The commission may be empowered to take action, or may be required to forward its findings to the regular courts.
hr.df: کمیسیونی مستقل برای تحقیق درباره‌ی نقض احتمالی حقوق بشر، که ممکن است خود اقدام کند یا یافته‌هایش را به دادگاه‌ها بفرستد.
hr.q: Does the constitution contain provisions for a human rights commission?

illadmin.d: Protects individuals from the use of excess power by administrative agencies of the government. Commonly also establishes procedures for review of such actions and provides redress for those harmed.
illadmin.df: حمایت از افراد در برابر زیاده‌روی دستگاه‌های اداری در اعمال قدرت؛ معمولن روال بازبینی این اقدام‌ها و جبران زیان را هم تعیین می‌کند.
illadmin.q: Does the constitution contain provisions protecting the individual against illegal or ultra-vires administrative actions?

illsub.fa: مواد مخدر، الکل و مواد ممنوع
illsub.d: Provisions about the regulation or criminalization of the trafficking, sale, or consumption of alcohol, drugs, or other controlled or illegal substances.
illsub.df: مقرراتی درباره‌ی تنظیم یا جرم‌انگاری قاچاق، فروش یا مصرف الکل، مواد مخدر یا دیگر مواد ممنوع.

immunity.d: Protection, whether absolute or limited, against prosecution for members of the legislature. This may involve protection against prosecution for certain kinds of crimes, or for a specified period of time.
immunity.df: مصونیت مطلق یا محدود نمایندگان از پیگرد، برای برخی جرم‌ها یا برای مدتی معین.
immunity.q: Does the constitution provide for immunity for the members of the legislature under some conditions?

inalrght.d: Rights that are understood to be unassailable, either because they are fundamental or “natural.”  In some countries, they may be absolute rights, not subject even to qualification.
inalrght.df: حقوقی که به‌سبب بنیادین یا «طبیعی» بودن خدشه‌ناپذیر دانسته می‌شوند و در برخی کشورها مطلق‌اند و هیچ قیدی نمی‌پذیرند.
inalrght.q: Does the constitution stipulate that the certain rights are inalienable or inviolable?

income.d: Specifies the actors involved in establishing the compensation of legislators. In addition to the legislature, this might involve the head of state, head of government, an independent commission, or other actors.
income.df: تعیین می‌کند چه نهادهایی دستمزد نمایندگان را مقرر می‌کنند؛ افزون بر مجلس، ممکن است رئیس کشور، رئیس دولت یا کمیسیونی مستقل باشد.
income.q: Who is involved in the determination of legislator's compensation?

indcit.d: Clarifies the citizenship status of members of indigenous groups. In some cases indigenous groups may be granted citizenship in a sub-national unit.
indcit.df: وضع تابعیت اعضای گروه‌های بومی را روشن می‌کند؛ گاه به آنان تابعیت یک واحد زیرملی داده می‌شود.
indcit.q: Are indigenous groups explicitly granted full citizenship?

indpolgr1.d: Specifically grants indigenous peoples the right to vote in national elections or referenda.
indpolgr1.df: به‌طور خاص حق رای در انتخابات یا همه‌پرسی‌های سراسری را به مردمان بومی می‌دهد.
indpolgr1.q: Are any of the following political rights or benefits specifically granted to indigenous groups?

indpolgr2.d: Grants indigenous peoples the right to representation in the central government. This might, for example, involve a seat quota in the legislature.
indpolgr2.df: حق نمایندگی مردمان بومی در حکومت مرکزی، برای نمونه با سهمیه‌ی کرسی در مجلس.
indpolgr2.q: Are any of the following political rights or benefits specifically granted to indigenous groups?

indpolgr3.d: Grants indigenous peoples the right to form political parties on the basis of group identity.
indpolgr3.df: حق مردمان بومی برای تشکیل حزب سیاسی بر پایه‌ی هویت گروهی.
indpolgr3.q: Are any of the following political rights or benefits specifically granted to indigenous groups?

indpolgr4.en: Indigenous right not to pay taxes
indpolgr4.d: Grants indigenous peoples an exemption from taxation by the central government.
indpolgr4.df: مردمان بومی را از مالیات حکومت مرکزی معاف می‌کند.
indpolgr4.q: Are any of the following political rights or benefits specifically granted to indigenous groups?

indpolgr5.d: Grants indigenous peoples the right to take part in activities that are illegal for the non-indigenous population.
indpolgr5.df: به مردمان بومی اجازه‌ی کارهایی را می‌دهد که برای دیگران غیرقانونی است.
indpolgr5.q: Are any of the following political rights or benefits specifically granted to indigenous groups?

indpolgr6.d: Grants indigenous peoples limited rights to self-government, particularly with regard to issues that affect their territory.
indpolgr6.df: حق محدود خودگردانی برای مردمان بومی، به‌ویژه در امور مربوط به سرزمینشان.
indpolgr6.q: Are any of the following political rights or benefits specifically granted to indigenous groups?

infoacc.d: Grants individuals access to information collected or held by the government, particularly information about oneself, or information of general public interest.
infoacc.df: حق دسترسی افراد به اطلاعاتی که حکومت گرد آورده یا در اختیار دارد، به‌ویژه اطلاعات مربوط به خود فرد یا اطلاعات مورد علاقه‌ی عمومی.
infoacc.q: Does the constitution provide for an individual right to view government files or documents under at least some conditions?

initiat.d: Allows private citizens to propose new legislation. Usually this requires additional qualifications, such as support from a political party, a member of the legislature, or a certain number of signatures from other citizens.
initiat.df: شهروندان می‌توانند قانون پیشنهاد کنند، معمولن با شرایطی مانند پشتیبانی یک حزب یا نماینده یا شمار معینی امضا.
initiat.q: Does the constitution provide for the ability of individuals to propose legislative initiatives (referenda from below)?

interp.d: Describes which bodies of government are empowered to interpret the constitution. This is commonly the role of a constitutional court or supreme court, but in some cases is a responsibility of all or a part of the legislature.
interp.df: تعیین می‌کند کدام نهاد قانون اساسی را تفسیر می‌کند؛ معمولن دادگاه قانون اساسی یا دیوان عالی، و گاه همه یا بخشی از مجلس.
interp.q: To whom does the constitution assign the responsibility for the interpretation of the constitution?

intlaw.d: Reference to international law, including treaties, agreements, norms, or other commitments.
intlaw.df: اشاره به حقوق بین‌الملل، از جمله معاهده‌ها، توافق‌ها، هنجارها یا دیگر تعهدات.
intlaw.q: Does the constitution contain provisions concerning the relationship between the constitution and international law?

intorgs.d: Reference to international organizations, whether generally or with regard to specific international organizations such as the United Nations.
intorgs.df: اشاره به سازمان‌های بین‌المللی، به‌طور کلی یا به سازمانی معین مانند سازمان ملل متحد.
intorgs.q: Does the constitution contain provisions concerning international organizations?

intprop.d: Gives individuals and businesses the exclusive right to protect and profit from their creative works.
intprop.df: حق انحصاری افراد و بنگاه‌ها بر آفریده‌های خود و بهره بردن از آن‌ها.
intprop.q: Does the constitution mention any of the following intellectual property rights?

intrght.d: Reference to one or more specific international treaties or instruments concerning human rights.
intrght.df: اشاره به یک یا چند معاهده یا سند بین‌المللی معین در زمینه‌ی حقوق بشر.
intrght.q: Does the constitution refer to any of the following international treaties or instruments?

invexe.d: Mechanisms that allow the legislative branch to ensure that executive agencies are enforcing the laws according to the intent of the legislature. Also provides a check on the misuse or abuse of executive power.
invexe.df: سازوکارهایی که مجلس با آن‌ها اطمینان می‌یابد دستگاه‌های اجرایی قانون را مطابق خواست قانون‌گذار اجرا می‌کنند، و مهاری بر سوءاستفاده از قدرت اجرایی.
invexe.q: Does the legislature have the power to interpellate members of the executive branch, or similarly, is the executive responsible for reporting its activities to the legislature on a regular basis?

jc.d: Establishes a special body to monitor judges. Judicial councils are commonly tasked with reviewing complaints about judges, and are sometimes involved in selecting, promoting, and removing judges.
jc.df: نهادی ویژه برای نظارت بر قضات که معمولن به شکایت‌ها از قضات رسیدگی می‌کند و گاه در گزینش، ارتقا و برکناری آنان نقش دارد.
jc.q: Does the constitution contain provisions for a judicial council/commission?

jointrde.d: Grants individuals the right to form and join trade unions or professional associations. This is an explicit right that goes beyond freedom of association.
jointrde.df: حق تشکیل و پیوستن به سندیکا یا انجمن صنفی، فراتر از آزادی انجمن‌ها.
jointrde.q: Does the constitution provide for the right to form or to join trade unions?

jrem.fa: برکناری قضات دیوان عالی و دادگاه‌های عادی
jrem.d: In cases where a judge has committed a crime, or otherwise compromised the integrity of their office, he or she may be removed from office. This may be carried out by the legislature, the executive, or another competent body.
jrem.df: برکناری قاضی‌ای که جرمی مرتکب شده یا درستکاری منصبش را خدشه‌دار کرده است، به دست مجلس، قوه‌ی مجریه یا نهادی صلاحیت‌دار.
jrem.q: Are there provisions for dismissing judges?

judcrts1.d: Courts that adjudicate disputes about the government's exercise of power in ordinary administrative functions.
judcrts1.df: دادگاه‌هایی که به اختلاف‌ها درباره‌ی اعمال قدرت حکومت در کارکردهای عادی اداری رسیدگی می‌کنند.
judcrts1.q: For which of the following specialized courts does the constitution contain provisions?

judcrts2.d: A court that is especially empowered to interpret the constitution, and usually to rule on whether legislation is in accord with the principles of the constitution.
judcrts2.df: دادگاهی با اختیار ویژه‌ی تفسیر قانون اساسی که معمولن درباره‌ی سازگاری قوانین با قانون اساسی رای می‌دهد.
judcrts2.q: For which of the following specialized courts does the constitution contain provisions?

judcrts3.d: Courts that review government actions to determine whether an individual's rights were infringed or violated.
judcrts3.df: دادگاه‌هایی که بررسی می‌کنند آیا کارهای حکومت حقوق فرد را نقض کرده است یا نه.
judcrts3.q: For which of the following specialized courts does the constitution contain provisions?

judcrts4.d: Courts with jurisdiction limited to charges against members of the military, and tasked with enforcing military law.
judcrts4.df: دادگاه‌هایی با صلاحیت محدود به اتهام‌های نظامیان و اجرای قانون نظامی.
judcrts4.q: For which of the following specialized courts does the constitution contain provisions?

judcrts5.fa: دادگاه‌های رسیدگی به تخلف مقام‌های عمومی
judcrts5.d: Special courts that are empowered to review the actions of public servants acting in their official capacity.
judcrts5.df: دادگاه‌های ویژه برای بازبینی کارهای کارگزاران عمومی در مقام رسمی‌شان.
judcrts5.q: For which of the following specialized courts does the constitution contain provisions?

judcrts6.d: Courts with limited jurisdiction to adjudicate disputes between individuals or businesses and the state with regard to taxation.
judcrts6.df: دادگاه‌هایی با صلاحیت محدود به اختلاف افراد یا بنگاه‌ها با دولت درباره‌ی مالیات.
judcrts6.q: For which of the following specialized courts does the constitution contain provisions?

judcrts7.d: Courts with limited jurisdiction to adjudicate disputes between individuals or trade unions and businesses.
judcrts7.df: دادگاه‌هایی با صلاحیت محدود به اختلاف کارگران یا سندیکاها با کارفرمایان.
judcrts7.q: For which of the following specialized courts does the constitution contain provisions?

judcrts8.d: Courts with limited jurisdiction to adjudicate matters arising in religious law. Jurisdiction may be limited on a confessional basis.
judcrts8.df: دادگاه‌هایی با صلاحیت محدود به امور شرعی، که گاه بر پایه‌ی مذهب افراد محدود می‌شود.
judcrts8.q: For which of the following specialized courts does the constitution contain provisions?

judind.d: An explicit declaration that judges are autonomous or the judiciary as a whole is independent. This may include protection from outside influence on their decision making, particularly from other branches of the government.
